title: Lebesgue's inequality ∫⁻ over (a, b) of F′ ≤ F(b) − F(a) for monotone F
statement: Let F : ℝ → ℝ be nondecreasing and a, b ∈ ℝ. Then ∫⁻_{t ∈ (a, b)} ENNReal.ofReal(F′(t)) dt ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(F(b) − F(a)). Here F′(t) = deriv F t is the derivative where it exists and 0 otherwise, and ∫⁻ is the [0, ∞]-valued lower Lebesgue integral.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), Monotone F → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, ENNReal.ofReal (deriv F t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (F b - F a)
